learning_outcomes.text: Understand measurement processes of electrical quantities, as well as measuring methods for different physical/chemical quantities.
Understand measuring systems errors, as well as instrument principle for data collection.
Conceive electronic measuring systems for satisfying specific needs.

syllabus_topics: Measuring methods and errors: standards and calibration.
Measurement of electrical quantities. DC and AC measurements.
Electronic measuring systems: measure of frequency, voltage, phase, current, power and energy.
Measuring temperature, light, magnetic fields, .pressure, displacement, levels, gases/humidity, rotation and acceleration.
Analog signal conditioning in instrumentation. measuring bridges, Filters. Instrumentation amplifiers.
Analog to digital and digital to analog converters.
Oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, function/signal generators and multimeters.
LabVIEW introduction.Using LabVIEW in the development of mesuring systems.
bibliography: Blackburn, J. A. (2001) - Modern Instrumentation for Scientists and Engineers, Springer.
Northop, R. B. (2005) - Introduction to instrumentation and measurements, 2. ed., Taylor & Francis.
Jones, L. D. (1991) - Electronic instruments and measurements, 2. ed., Prentice-Hall.
Travis, Jeffrey (2001) - LabVIEW for Everyone, Prentice Hall.
Jamal, R. (1999) - LabVIEW applications and solutions, Prentice Hall.
Johnson, G. W. (1997) - LabVIEW graphical programming: practical applications in instrumentation and control, McGraw-Hill.
degree: Licenciatura em Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (LEEC)
